integrity: All formulas derive from a facewise 1-Lipschitz distance certificate and explicit planar disk-intersection integration; numerical checks are auxiliary.
scientific_limitations: The formula concerns a fixed vertex and a single area-uniform surface point, not two random points, not ambient distance, and not arbitrary cuboids. Historical priority remains provisional; related older ambient-distance work has not been read in full.
title: Exact intrinsic vertex-distance law on the surface of a unit cube
